phase: ESA2010 semantic-adjusted OECD aggregate exact-value/reconciliation gate

official_consistency_context.documented_internal_state: Romanian national financial accounts are compiled who-to-whom in an integrated system and are reported as internally consistent with no asset/liability discrepancies by construction.
official_consistency_context.implication_for_this_gate: The small public OECD aggregate residuals cannot be assumed to be structural model imbalances, but no official quantitative dissemination-rounding tolerance was preregistered or found that authorizes changing the frozen 0.1 million RON gate after observing results.

precision_context.reason: A post-result tolerance change would violate preregistration and would convert a diagnostic observation into a rescue rule.

future_reopen_condition: No immediate rerun is authorized. Reopen only on materially changed official evidence that changes the public numerical precision/balancing boundary, or on an independent official dissemination-precision rule established and preregistered before any future value gate. The observed 0.5-0.6 million RON residuals alone do not authorize a new tolerance.
